colluvial: Small headwater channel at the tips of the network, flowing over colluvial valley
fill, with weak or ephemeral fluvial transport. Fluvial processes do not control
deposition or sorting; periodically scoured by debris flows.
bedrock: No continuous alluvial bed; little or no valley fill; usually confined by valley
walls; steeper than alluvial channels with similar drainage area. Alluvial pockets
may occur in scour holes or behind obstructions.
cascade: Steep, narrowly confined; disorganised cobble-boulder bed; energy dissipated by
tumbling and jet-and-wake flow over large clasts; small pools spaced less than one
channel width apart; largest clasts can approach bankfull flow depth and move only
step_pool: Discrete channel-spanning steps (boulder, cobble, wood or bedrock) separating plunge
pools; pools spaced about 1-4 channel widths apart; step heights comparable to
annual high-flow depth; steep, confined, small width-to-depth.
plane_bed: Long stretches of featureless bed without discrete bars or rhythmic pools; low
width-to-depth ratio and high relative roughness (bar formation unlikely at relative
pool_riffle: Laterally oscillating bed: alternating bars, pools and riffles; pools about 5-7
channel widths apart in self-formed channels; free bar formation limited to
gradients <= 0.02; typically gravel bed, unconfined, with floodplain.
dune_ripple: Low-gradient, typically sand-bed channel with mobile, multilayered bedforms
(ripples, dunes, sand waves, bars) under live-bed transport; low relative roughness;

value_definitions.alluvial: Bed is a continuous cover of fluvially transported and sorted sediment.
value_definitions.bedrock: Exposed bedrock forms most of the bed; no continuous alluvial cover.
colluvial: Bed is hillslope-derived valley fill (colluvium) with weak or ephemeral fluvial

substrate_origin.source: MB1997 (three channel-reach substrates: bedrock, alluvium, colluvium)

value_definitions.multilayered: Superimposed mobile bedforms (ripples on dunes, sand waves, bars) in a sand bed.
value_definitions.laterally_oscillatory: Alternating bars and pools across the channel, with riffles between pools.
value_definitions.featureless: Planar bed without rhythmic bars, pools or steps over several channel widths.
value_definitions.vertically_oscillatory: Channel-spanning steps (abrupt bed drops) separating plunge pools.
random: Disorganised large clasts; no rhythmic bedform; tumbling, jet-and-wake flow; small
pools less than one width apart.
value_definitions.irregular: Sculpted bedrock surface (ledges, chutes, potholes); no continuous alluvial bed.

confinement.measurement: Ratio thresholds are operational and may be changed; record the ratio.
confinement.source: MB1997 Table 1 (typical confinement); ratio thresholds operational

true: At least one pool per 10 channel widths: a bed depression spanning at least half the

value_definitions.false: No such pools over the reach.

pools_present.source: MB1997 Table 1 (pool spacing 'none' for plane bed); pool definition operational

scoring_model.type: weighted naive-Bayes log score with softmax normalisation
numeric_membership: m = exp(-0.5 * ((log10(x) - log10_mu) / log10_sigma)^2); mu = midpoint of
log10(q25), log10(q75); sigma = max((log10(q75) - log10(q25)) / 1.349, sigma_min)
scoring_model.missing_feature: skip the feature for all classes (no contribution)
scoring_model.probability: p_c = exp(S_c - max_k S_k) / sum_j exp(S_j - max_k S_k)
scoring_model.default_prior: uniform (1/7 each); empirical class frequencies allowed if reported
forced_pool_riffle_rule: If obstruction_forced is true, the slope parameters for pool_riffle use the union
range q25=0.002, q75=0.03 (MB1997: forced pool-riffle reaches span the slope ranges
scoring_model.pool_spacing_rule: pool_spacing is used only when pools_present == 'true'.

decision_rules.predicted_class: argmax_c p_c (ties broken by order in 'classes')
transitional_flag: true if p_top1 - p_top2 < 0.15 and the two classes are adjacent in
forced_variant: if obstruction_forced is true and predicted_class is pool_riffle ->
'forced_pool_riffle'; if step_pool -> 'forced_step_pool'; else null. Forced variants
count as their parent class for AUC.
out_of_scope: if multithread is true -> 'braided' (BM2013/BM2022 add braided as an eighth type;
not one of the seven MB1997 types). Scores are still produced; exclude these reaches
decision_rules.low_evidence_flag: true if the summed weight of features used is < 1.5

description: No bed-morphology observations: quantitative proxies only. Use when the ground-truth
labels were assigned visually from bed morphology, to avoid label leakage.

input_schema.pool_spacing: float (channel widths per pool) or null
input_schema.obstruction_forced: bool or null: most pools/steps formed by large wood or other obstructions
input_schema.multithread: bool or null: more than one active channel at bankfull

output_schema.probabilities: object: one float per class in 'classes', sum = 1
output_schema.features_used: list of feature names that contributed

ground_truth: one of the seven classes per reach; map forced variants to their parent class;
primary_metric: macro one-vs-rest ROC AUC: mean over classes with at least one positive and one
secondary_metrics: per-class one-vs-rest AUC with n_pos and n_neg
auc_protocol.uncertainty: stratified bootstrap over reaches, 1000 resamples, 95% percentile CI
